title: HuLa SDK Pin
description: Release-branch pin that binds the HuLa frontend to a specific matrix-js-sdk artifact and (transitively) to a synapse-rust commit. Enforced by scripts/verify-sdk-pin.mjs.

sdk_version.description: SemVer from matrix-js-sdk/package.json at pin time. May be empty on dev branches.

sdk_commit.description: Git SHA of the matrix-js-sdk checkout.

pinned_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp, empty on dev branches.
